heard: The sons of Jeromeel are told from Hezron's firstborn line Rambona, Orinozin, and Ahijah shine Another wife was added, she bore the son alone Shammai and Jada followed through the years to come Sheshon had no sons, only daughters, he gave his child away To Jarhah, his Egyptian servant, in that simple day A tithe came from that union, Nathan then Zavah The fallen dovet followed in the written record The least of fathered sins
